q: Ice-cream sales and drownings have a correlation of 0.9, so ice cream causes drowning.
why: Myth. Hot weather drives both. Correlation alone can't show causation.

q: A correlation of 0 means there is no relationship.
why: It means no straight-line relationship. y = x² with x from −3 to 3 has r = 0, but y depends completely on x.

q: The fitted line is wage = a + 0.8 · years. What does 0.8 mean?
o: Each extra year goes with about 0.8 more wage, on average
why: The slope is the change in y for one more unit of x.

o: The line explains 25% of the variation in y
why: R² is the share of y's variance the line accounts for. Here the correlation is ±0.5.

q: r = −0.6. Find R² for the simple regression.
why: R² = r² = 0.36. It can't be negative.
